briefdescription.para: Phase 1–6 contract-hardening tests for the performance module.

detaileddescription.para:
Test IDs: PFM-01..PFM-16
Coverage: compiler timeout, cache miss/hit contracts, pool exhaustion, cost-model boundary, load-balancer no-healthy-node, plan staleness, stats availability, concurrency invariants.
All tests use deterministic, in-process fixtures only — no file I/O, no network, kSeed = 42.
